tools.name: network_scan
tools.description: Scan a target host for open ports using Nmap. Returns structured results including open ports and service names.

target.description: Target hostname or IP address to scan (e.g., '192.168.1.1' or 'example.com')

tools.name: check_auth_log
tools.description: Parse authentication log file for failed login attempts within a lookback window.

log_path.description: Path to the authentication log file (e.g., '/var/log/auth.log' or 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\winevt\\Logs\\Security.evtx')

lookback_hours.description: Hours to look back for failed login attempts

tools.name: system_health
tools.description: Get system health metrics including CPU usage, memory usage, and top processes by resource consumption.

tools.name: list_processes
tools.description: List running processes, optionally filtered by name.

filter.description: Optional process name filter (case-insensitive substring match)
